title: Vercel button
description: A medium-weight button in two looks: an ink fill with white text, or a white fill with a 1px hairline ring. Pill-shaped at 40px for heroes and closing bands, or a small 32px box with 6px corners for the header. Hover deepens the fill (ink lifts to dark grey, white to a pale grey) over 150ms.
notes: renders a link when href is set, a button otherwise
accepts icons as children (they are sized to 16px)
name: vercel-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: ink fill · secondary: white fill with a hairline ring

props.name: shape
props.description: pill: 40px, fully round, 16px label (hero, closing band) · box: 32px, 6px corners, 14px label (header)

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the full width of the parent

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it renders a button

props.name: onClick
props.description: click handler when it renders a button
